title: የደሴው ሬዲዮ ጠጋኝ (The Radio Craftsman of Dessie)
logline: In the misty highlands of Dessie, a young boy learns that broken radios and broken days can be mended with patience, copper wire, and an attentive ear—a lesson in craftsmanship that bridges generations.

style_block.visual_style: Cinematic heritage photography, 35mm film grain, rich earth tones, warm tungsten glow, Kodachrome vintage aesthetic
style_block.lighting: Golden hour morning light filtering through wooden shutters, soft chiaroscuro volumetric dust motes, warm amber tube filament glow
style_block.color_palette: Deep ochre, terracotta, highland eucalyptus green, weathered mahogany, burnished copper, warm glowing amber
style_block.cinematography: Gentle fluid camera movement, shallow depth of field, 50mm and 85mm prime lens perspective, centered subjects for dual 16:9 and 9:16 safe areas

character_sheets.name: Young Girma (Age 10)
character_sheets.description: Ethiopian highland boy, 10 years old, wide curious dark eyes, short cropped black hair, wearing a warm handwoven cream Gabi shawl over a dark woolen vest, expressive hands carrying small tools
character_sheets.reference_prompt: Portrait of a 10-year-old Ethiopian boy in 1978 Dessie highlands, wide observant dark brown eyes, handwoven off-white cotton gabi draped over shoulders, warm morning light, cinematic vintage film look, shallow depth of field

character_sheets.name: Elder Girma (Age 58)
character_sheets.description: Distinguished Ethiopian elder craftsman and mentor, silver-streaked hair, kind laugh lines around eyes, wearing modern linen shirt under traditional knitted vest, serene wisdom in expression
character_sheets.reference_prompt: Portrait of a 58-year-old Ethiopian man with gentle smiling eyes, silver-dusted hair, wearing a dark olive linen cardigan, warm study room background with books and electronics, natural soft portrait lighting

character_sheets.name: Grandfather Assefa
character_sheets.description: Venerable Ethiopian patriarch, flowing white beard, wearing white netela and round horn-rimmed reading glasses, dignified posture sitting by wooden window
character_sheets.reference_prompt: Venerable elderly Ethiopian grandfather with neat white beard, round glasses, draped in clean white netela cloth, seated near rustic window overlooking misty green hills, soft natural backlight

music_theme.instrumentation: Solo masenqo (one-string bowed lute), gentle acoustic krar plucks, warm atmospheric cello drone, soft bamboo washint flutes
music_theme.ace_step_caption: Slow melancholic traditional Ethiopian Tizita melody, solo acoustic masenqo bowed strings, gentle contemplative krar harp plucks, warm low cello drone, authentic nostalgic atmosphere, 68 BPM, instrumental, room acoustics, cinematic score

shots.camera_motion: Slow forward aerial dolly over mist-veiled hills towards cobblestone streets
shots.visual_prompt: Extreme wide cinematic establishing view of Dessie Ethiopia in early morning mist, rolling green Wollo mountains, tin and stone rooftops glowing under golden sunrise, woodsmoke drifting gently into crisp highland air, Kodak 35mm grain
shots.motion_prompt: Slow smooth push-in camera through drifting morning fog over mountain valley, distant chimney smoke curling upward

narration.amharic: ደሴ ላይ ንጋት የሚጀምረው በጭጋግ እና በቡና ሽታ ብቻ አልነበረም፤ በመንደሩ የሬዲዮ ድምፅ ጭምር እንጂ።
narration.english_subtitle: Dawn in Dessie did not just begin with mist and roasted coffee; it began with the village radio.
narration.voice_style: Warm, contemplative, measured elder storytelling voice

music_cue.mood: Evocative opening, solo masenqo establishing the Tizita motif

shots.reason: Establishes geographical place, era, and emotional atmosphere of the Wollo highlands before introducing the characters.

shots.camera_motion: Slow tilt down from rustic mud-plaster wall to mahogany sideboard
shots.visual_prompt: Medium interior shot of a vintage 1970s Philips valve radio resting on a polished mahogany side table, silent wooden dial, brass speaker grille covered in slight dust, golden window light illuminating dust motes
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle tilt down and slow subtle zoom on dusty vintage radio, dust motes floating slowly in golden sunlight beam

narration.amharic: አባቴ ጊርማ የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ እያለ፣ ያ ትልቅ የእንጨት ሬዲዮ የቤቱ ልብ ነበር።
narration.english_subtitle: When my father Girma was eight, that grand wooden radio was the beating heart of our home.

music_cue.mood: Subtle krar plucks join the masenqo drone

shots.reason: Introduces the central artifact of the story—the family radio—and frames it as the emotional center of the household.

shots.camera_motion: Static locked-off camera with slight handheld breath
shots.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of Grandfather Assefa sitting by the window in white netela, turning the brass radio knob with wrinkled weathered fingers, hearing only cold crackling static, disappointment and quiet concern in his aged eyes
shots.motion_prompt: Wrinkled fingers gently turn brass dial knob back and forth, grandfather shakes head softly with slight sigh

narration.amharic: አንድ ቀን ምሽት ግን ዜናው ጠፋ። ሬዲዮው ዝም አለ፤ አያቴም በፀጥታው ውስጥ ረጅም የሃሳብ ትንፋሽ ተነፈሰ።
narration.english_subtitle: One evening, the broadcast vanished. The radio fell silent; grandfather breathed a heavy sigh into the stillness.

music_cue.mood: Music thins to a faint sustained cello note, underscoring silence and loss

shots.reason: Inciting incident: the radio breaks, breaking the routine and leaving grandfather isolated from the outside world.

shots.camera_motion: Slow low-angle push-in toward child's face
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of young 10-year-old Girma peeking behind the wooden radio cabinet, curious wide brown eyes illuminated by warm amber glow of glass vacuum tubes, fascinated expression, dark woolen vest
shots.motion_prompt: Child peeks around wooden cabinet edge, eyes widening in wonder as warm amber light reflects on his cheeks

narration.amharic: ግን ጊርማ ዝምታውን እንደ ፍፃሜ ሳይሆን እንደ ሚስጥር ነበር የተመለከተው።
narration.english_subtitle: Yet young Girma did not view silence as an ending, but as an invitation into a secret.
narration.voice_style: Intrigued, spark of curiosity and wonder

music_cue.mood: A bright high krar harmonic note rings out, signaling discovery

shots.reason: Shifts perspective to the boy's curiosity; reveals the internal glowing tubes and shifts mood from grief to wonder.

shots.camera_motion: Extreme slow lateral tracking across electronic chassis
shots.visual_prompt: Extreme macro close-up of vacuum tubes, coiled red copper inductors, ceramic capacitors, and a snapped thin copper wire resting loose against chassis, warm tungsten illumination, cinematic depth of field
shots.motion_prompt: Micro camera tracks slowly across glowing glass tube filaments and coiled copper wires, thin curl of rosin smoke rises gently

narration.amharic: በመስታወት አምፑሎች እና በተጠላለፉ የመዳብ ሽቦዎች መሃል የተበጠሰች ትንሽ ክር አገኘ።
narration.english_subtitle: Amidst glowing glass bulbs and tangled copper coils, he found a single severed wire.

music_cue.mood: Rhythmic plucked pattern begins, tension of problem solving

shots.reason: Diagnostic beat: demonstrates the engineer's eye spotting the single broken link that caused the entire system failure.

shots.camera_motion: Slow steady push-in on child's hands and face
shots.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of young Girma at a wooden workbench, carefully holding a hand-heated copper soldering iron, steady small hands touching solder to wire, tiny curl of fragrant rosin smoke rising, intense concentration on his brow
shots.motion_prompt: Young boy carefully lowers soldering iron tip, molten silver droplet flows cleanly onto copper joint, breath held in focus

narration.amharic: ያለ ትምህርት ቤት፣ ያለ ዲፕሎማ፤ በትዕግስት እና በእጅ ንፅህና ብቻ ሽቦዎቹን በሙቀት አጋጠማቸው።
narration.english_subtitle: Without school, without a diploma; with pure patience and steady hands, he bonded the wires with heat.
narration.voice_style: Reverent, emphasizing patience and innate craft

music_cue.mood: Masenqo and washint flute intertwine in a building crescendo

shots.reason: Core climax of action: the physical act of mending, celebrating indigenous problem-solving and youthful determination.

shots.camera_motion: Dynamic snap focus from hand to backlit amber speaker cloth
shots.visual_prompt: Close-up of young Girma's index finger gently turning the bakelite tuning dial, backlight glowing behind the fabric grille, needle sliding across printed station names Dessie, Addis Ababa, Harar
shots.motion_prompt: Hand rotates dial knob, station needle slides steadily along glass scale, sudden vibration in speaker cloth

narration.amharic: ቁልፉ ሲዞር… ድንገት ፍንጣቂ ድምፅ ተሰማ፣ ከዚያም ያ ናፍቆት የነበረው የጥላሁን ዘፈን ክፍሉን ሞላው!
narration.english_subtitle: With one turn of the dial… static burst into music, and Tilahun's beloved song filled the room!

music_cue.mood: Triumphant full burst of traditional Ethiopian pentatonic harmony

shots.reason: The catharsis and payoff: sound returns to the home, proving the boy's diagnosis and repair were successful.

shots.camera_motion: Slow gentle dolly out revealing both figures in golden room light
shots.visual_prompt: Warm medium two-shot in rustic living room: Grandfather Assefa laughing with moist joyful eyes, placing a weathered loving hand on young Girma's shoulder, young Girma looking up with modest pride, glowing radio singing between them
shots.motion_prompt: Grandfather smiles warmly and pats boy's shoulder in deep affection, boy beams with quiet pride

narration.amharic: አያቴ ጊርማን አቅፎ እንዲህ አለው፡ 'የተሰበረውን ነገር በጨዋ እጅ የነካ ሰው፣ ሰዎችንም ማዳመጥ ያውቃል'።
narration.english_subtitle: Grandfather embraced Girma and said: 'He who mends what is broken with gentle hands learns how to listen to the world.'

music_cue.mood: Warm resonant strings, deeply emotional and gentle

shots.reason: Emotional climax: the philosophical heart of the film. The grandfather's blessing anchors technical skill to human empathy.

shots.camera_motion: Slow lateral pan from restored vintage radio on shelf to modern laptop displaying code pipeline
shots.visual_prompt: Modern warm study room in 2026: Elder Girma at 58 with silver hair smiling gently, standing beside his daughter/grandson at a laptop displaying terminal code and neural model diagrams, original 1970s radio proudly resting on bookshelf behind them
shots.motion_prompt: Elder Girma leans over laptop with warm reassuring smile, terminal screen displays flowing green pipeline logs, camera glides smoothly

narration.amharic: ዛሬ እኛም በኮምፒውተር የምንገነባው የሞዴል ቧንቧ፤ ያኔ አባቴ በደሴ ካገናኘው የመዳብ ሽቦ ፈፅሞ አይለይም።
narration.english_subtitle: Today, the neural pipelines we craft in code are no different from the copper wires my father soldered in Dessie.

music_cue.mood: Modern synthesizer pad blends seamlessly under traditional masenqo, bridging past and future

shots.reason: The thematic bridge: connects the analog physical craftsmanship of 1978 Dessie directly to modern AI engineering in 2026.

shots.camera_motion: Static slow luminous pulse on typography
shots.visual_prompt: Cinematic dark ochre textured end card, elegant centered typography in gold and white: 'የደሴው ሬዲዮ ጠጋኝ - The Radio Craftsman of Dessie'. Subtitle: 'Crafted with AI: Gemini 3.8 Flash, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step 1.5, FFmpeg'. Small emblem of traditional masenqo and neural graph, pristine cinematic finish
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle luminous shimmer across golden text, slow fade to gentle warm black vignette

narration.amharic: የጥበብ ውርስ ይቀጥላል። ይሄ ፊልም በሰው ራዕይ እና በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ታግዞ የተሰራ ነው።
narration.english_subtitle: The legacy of craft endures. Crafted with human vision and Artificial Intelligence.

music_cue.mood: Final resolved Tizita chord with soft masenqo tail decaying into silence

shots.reason: AI transparency end card required by assignment guidelines, providing formal attribution, consent closure, and final artistic resolution.
